project.objective: Identify every occurrence of the surname Czelusniak in the Wójtowa, Pagorzyna and Lipinki parish registers (FamilySearch DGS 004118433), to find Marianna Czelusniak's parents and siblings.

questions.question: Which relatives of Marianna Czelusniak (I1) appear under the surname Czelusniak across the Wójtowa, Pagorzyna and Lipinki parish registers (DGS 004118433)?
questions.rationale: Marianna's parents and siblings are not yet in the tree. A survey of every occurrence of the surname in the three parishes' digitized registers, rather than a search for her own marriage record alone, is the only way to surface them from this index.

items.jurisdiction: Wójtowa, Pagorzyna and Lipinki, Gorlice, Województwo Rzeszów, Polska
items.rationale: A survey of every occurrence of the surname Czelusniak across the digitized parish registers (FamilySearch DGS 004118433, Poland, Church Books collection 4135958) — not a search for one person's own record.
